notes.title: build 383 (18.07.2023) - patch notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added gamepad text input support when playing in Steam Big Picture mode
[*] Fixed some gamepad navigation issues in level editor
[*] Fixed touchscreen camera controls not working when playing workshop levels
[*] Fixed some touchscreen buttons not working in regular mode
[/list]

notes.title: The game now has a speedrun.com page!
notes.content:
[h2]Full game speedrun page:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864372/24052b855ad8e90dbbe858fdcdd1efb2f81c968d.png[/img]
[h3][url=https://www.speedrun.com/locomotorica_staggering_ragdoll]https://www.speedrun.com/locomotorica_staggering_ragdoll[/url][/h3]

[h2]Individual levels page:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864372/56761c9c3f36776e29e1a9341b44487651188609.png[/img]
[h3][url=https://www.speedrun.com/locomotorica_staggering_ragdoll/levels]https://www.speedrun.com/locomotorica_staggering_ragdoll/levels[/url][/h3]

[h3][b]Please feel free to submit your best times for individual levels from Steam Leaderboards.[/b]
[hr][/hr]

The game also has built-in support for [b]LiveSplit[/b]. To make it work with [b]LiveSplit[/b], install and activate [b]LiveSplit.Server[/b] by following instructions here:
[url=https://github.com/LiveSplit/LiveSplit.Server]https://github.com/LiveSplit/LiveSplit.Server[/url]

Then download splits from here:
[url=https://www.speedrun.com/locomotorica_staggering_ragdoll/resources]https://www.speedrun.com/locomotorica_staggering_ragdoll/resources[/url][/h3]

notes.title: build 377 (22.06.2023) - patch notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed final split not triggering when using LiveSplit.Server in time attack mode
[/list]

notes.title: build 375 (06.06.2023) - patch notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added preliminary support for LiveSplit.Server
[*] Made 40 km/h running task easier

[b]Scripting API:[/b]
[*] Renamed LevelManager.Playing to LevelManager.TimerRunning
[*] Renamed LevelManager.Unpause() to LevelManager.StartTimer()
[*] Renamed LevelManager.Pause() to LevelManager.StopTimer()
[/list]

notes.title: build 374 (31.05.2023) - patch notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Reordered some tasks in an effort to make difficulty curve smoother
[/list]

notes.title: build 373 (30.05.2023) - patch notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added replay recording support for workshop levels
[*] Added a reference to Unity.TextMeshPro.dll for scripting
[*] Fixed invalid script execution order when playing workshop levels outside of editor
[*] Fixed CanvasScaler component not saving in editor
[*] Fixed error when toggling Behaviour.enabled property in editor in some cases
[/list]

notes.title: build 372 (29.05.2023) - patch notes
